name: Desert Survival Kits
label: Quest
description: Desert Survival Kits: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert. Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers. Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
